verses.text: Then Elihu continued:
“You three men who think that you [SAR] are very wise, hear me;
When we [SYN] hear what other people like you say,
We need to decide who is saying what is right
Job has said, ‘I am innocent,
Even though I have always done what is right,
◄Is there any person like Job, who insults others as easily as people accept a drink of water?/There is no person like Job, who insults others as easily as people accept a drink of water.► [RHQ]
He habitually associates with people who do what is evil
He has said, ‘It is useless for people to try to please God.’
“So, you men who claim that you understand everything, listen to me!
He ◄pays back/punishes► people for what they have done;
Truly, Almighty God never does what is wicked;
The authority that he has to rule everything on the earth, no one [RHQ] gave it to him;
If he would take his spirit back to himself,
everyone would die immediately,
“So, Job, if you say that you understand everything,
God could certainly not [RHQ] govern the world if he hated doing what is fair/just.
He tells some kings that they are worthless,
He does not favor rulers more than he favors others;
People often die suddenly;
“He sees [MTY] everything that people do;
There is no gloom or darkness [DOU] that is so dark
God does not need to set a time
He destroys mighty people without needing to investigate what they have done,
Because he already knows what they have done,
Where many people can see it,
he strikes them because they turned away from doing what he wanted them to do
They mistreated the poor people,
But if God decides to do nothing to punish wicked people,
and if God hides his face with the result that he does not see that ruler or punish him,
“Job, have you or anyone else ever said to God, ‘I have been punished for my sins,
so teach/show me what sins I have committed;
Job, you object to what God has done to you,
“People who have good sense, those who are wise and who listen to what I say,
‘Job is speaking ignorantly;
I think that Job should be taken to a court and ◄put on trial/judged►,
To add to the other sins that he has committed, he is rebelling against God;
